tasks.title: Implement a continuous run-until-empty harness loop
acceptance_criteria: The harness can continue pulling the next eligible todo task automatically without requiring a new manual step invocation after each completed task

`scripts/agent_loop.py` now treats `run` as a queue-draining loop: it waits on a valid active lock, halts on stray unlocked `agent_loop.py` processes, keeps draining after both `done` and `rejected` outcomes, and stops cleanly on `no_tasks`, `paused`, or an explicit `--max-iterations` cap.

`.agent/config.json` now defines `lock_poll_seconds`, and `docs/operations/agent-loop-runbook.md` documents continuous drain mode, quarantine recovery, lock polling, and stale-process recovery expectations.
Re-ran `python3 -m unittest -v tests/test_agent_loop.py`; all 19 harness tests passed, including the new continuous-run, lock-wait, max-iteration, and stray-process coverage.
Re-ran `python3 scripts/agent_loop.py doctor`; it returned `ok: true` with no issues and only the existing warning that runner auth was not live-verified.
last_result.next_action: Commit and push the harness-only change set, then start `python3 scripts/agent_loop.py run --runner codex` to resume autonomous task draining.
last_result.summary: Approved. The harness now supports clean worktree quarantine recovery and a true serial run-until-empty loop with lock polling, stale-process detection, updated docs, and focused regression coverage.
